# Board

1. Find the Orc-istration checkout: the "Setup checkout (this machine)" line in the rulebook's tool notes, else `setupCheckout` in `~/.orc/config.json`, else ask the user. Call it CHECKOUT and confirm `CHECKOUT/orchestration/board.md` exists there; if it does not, stop and say so.
2. Read `CHECKOUT/orchestration/board.md` and follow it. On Claude Code, the artifact backend (`claude.ai/artifact/...`) is written with ArtifactData: load it with ToolSearch `select:ArtifactData`. If it is absent, load `select:mcp__claude-artifacts__db_get,mcp__claude-artifacts__db_write`, resolve the address to its UUID slug first (the short id fails), and pass `ifVersion` on every write to an existing doc. Refuters, scouts and researchers have a tools allowlist without MCP tools here, so they cannot write the board: give a refuter's brief `BOARD: none`, and after it reports, write its stage, `note` and `tokens` yourself.
